name: Incipient Wetness Impregnation - Metal on Oxide Support
description: Incipient wetness (dry) impregnation: precursor solution equal to the support pore volume, so there is no excess liquid to separate. Followed by drying and calcination. Compare with the excess-solution route, which adds filtration and loses precursor to the mother liquor.
route_note: Renamed from 'Wet Impregnation'. The step list has never contained a filtration stage, which is the defining difference between the two routes, so the previous name described a route this template does not model.
source: Jimenez et al., Industrial Catalyst Impregnation: Modern Equipment, Techniques, and Scaling Challenges, Ind. Eng. Chem. Res. 65, 12447 (2026)

step_quantities.note: Solution volume matched to support pore volume
Calcination. Sub with batch kiln at small scale
